name: Sub drone
desc: Subliminal sine sub for liquid & deep DnB: a descending Eb-minor walk (Eb-Db-Cb-Bb) one chord per cycle, shaped for weight, breathing under an isaw pump. Sparse is a long swell; full and peak chop it into rhythmic sub pulses with an every-8 octave lift.

code.full: note("<[eb1 ~ eb1 eb1] [db1 ~ db1 db1] [b0 ~ b0 b0] [bb0 ~ bb0 bb0]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.005).decay(.1).sustain(.6).release(.2).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.9, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).shape(${drive}).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.75, ${gain}).fast(4)).room(.12).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[eb1 eb1 ~ eb1] [db1 db1 ~ db1] [b0 b0 ~ b0] [bb0 ~ bb0 bb0]>").add(note(${root})).s("sine").attack(.005).decay(.09).sustain(.5).release(.15).lpf(sine.range(${cut}, ${cut}*1.6).slow(8)).shape(${drive}).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.75, ${gain}).fast(4)).every(8, x=>x.add(note(12))).room(.1).orbit(3).play()
